title: SDW100 2026 Aid Stations — official archive
claims: The 2026 chart keeps QECP at mile 23.4 in 'The Event Field, Queen Elizabeth Country Park' and no longer carries the 'moved from its 2024 location' note.
The 2026 chart's 12 aid-station mileages match the 2025 and 2027 charts: 11.4, 23.4, 28, 36.6, 45, 55, 60.9, 66.6, 76.6, 84, 91.6 and 95.7, with the finish at 100.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 直接抓取并读取 2026 届补给站表，用于确认 2025 之后的位置与里程沿用。
